usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command. It charges 1% interest once on any invoice that is still unpaid more than 60 days after its due date. That interest counts toward the invoice's outstanding amount and the customer's balance, and `help` lists the command right after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 8 of 8, including two tests I added, and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
Open questions are in the report. Nonprofits are charged interest because DEC-B14 doesn't exempt them, though they are exempt from late fees. I read "`show` is unchanged" as the output format staying the same, so its outstanding figure now includes interest.
OUTCOME: completed
